title: Multi-Vector Zero-Spend Boundary Governor
problem: Safety gates check only immediate spend; recurring trial subscriptions and pre-auth holds pass unchecked.
evidence: Verified in WS2 (EXP-WS2-COMP-001) and WS9 (EXP-WS9-GOAL-001). Mutant MUT-08 killed.
proposed_change_boundary: Add multi-vector liability inspection for recurring, deferred, and pre-auth charges.
rollback: Fall back to immediate transaction amount check.
independent_verifier: Financial ledger auditor asserting real spend == 0.00 EUR.
known_risks: Zero-dollar trials with recurring terms will be rejected without human approval.
stop_condition: Spend > 0.00 EUR attempted without human gate signature.
